exposure: congenital lung developmental abnormalities/congenital diaphragmatic hernia (CDH)
outcome: death in newborns with persistent pulmonary hypertension (PPHN)
cohort: 161 neonates with persistent pulmonary hypertension (PPHN) from a neonatal center in China over the past ten years
finding: Cesarean delivery was negatively associated with death from PPHN, while PROM, congenital lung developmental abnormalities/CDH, RDS, iNO, and norepinephrine were positively associated with death from PPHN.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was a protective factor against death in neonates with PPHN.
